title: Flypost Event Schema v4 (Minimal)
description: Minimal schema definition for Flypost v4 Event, extending Schema.org's Event type with essential Flypost metadata.

@type.description: The Schema.org type for this object.

flypost.description: Essential Flypost-specific metadata for the event.

eventId.description: A unique identifier for the event within the Flypost system.

category.description: The primary category of the event within the Flypost system.

realTimeData.description: Indicates if this event represents real-time data that should be consumed proactively by agents.

crawlable.description: Indicates if this event's data is intended to be crawled by automated systems.

queryable.description: Indicates if this event's data is intended to be queryable via an API.

submissionTimestamp.description: The UTC timestamp when the event data was submitted to Flypost.

description.description: A detailed description of the event.

startDate.description: The start date and time of the event in ISO 8601 format.

endDate.description: The end date and time of the event in ISO 8601 format.

location.description: The location where the event will take place.

@type.description: The Schema.org type for the location.

name.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Main Street').

address.description: The postal address of the event location.

@type.description: The Schema.org type for the address.

streetAddress.description: The street address of the location.

postalCode.description: The postal code of the address.

geo.description: Geographical coordinates of the event location (optional).

@type.description: The Schema.org type for geographical coordinates.

organizer.description: The person or organization organizing the event. All fields are optional to support various data sources.

@type.description: The Schema.org type for the organizer. Can be a Person or Organization.

email.description: The email address of the organizer.

phone.description: The phone number of the organizer. Stored verbatim with no enforced formatting.

telephone.description: Deprecated: Use 'phone' instead. Legacy telephone number field retained for backward compatibility.

licenseId.description: The license ID of the organizer (e.g., real estate agent license number).

mlsNumber.description: The MLS listing number associated with the organizer's listing.

keywords.description: Keywords or tags associated with the event.

hash.description: Cryptographic hash of the event data for integrity verification and future DLT anchoring.

encoding.description: The encoding format of the hash value.

value.description: The hexadecimal hash value (64 characters for SHA-256).

canonicalVersion.description: Version number of the canonical representation used for hashing.
